name: [UPD 4] Night At The Infirmary (Anomaly)
desc:
🌙 You’ve been hired for the night shift.

Welcome to the Infirmary.

Patients will arrive throughout the night.
Examine them carefully, some may not be what they seem...

⚠️ Flashing lights and jumpscares
🎧 Headphones recommended
⬆️ High graphics recommended

This game is in Beta, please report any bugs on the forums and community server!

Visually inspired by DOORS and The Mortuary Assistant

(Anomaly, Haunted, Hospital, Scary, Jumpscare)
